title: Justice Yogesh Khanna appointed NCLAT officiating chairperson
description: The Central government has appointed Justice Yogesh Khanna as the officiating chairperson of the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT).The appointment follows the retirement of Justice Ashok Bhushan as NCLAT chairperson on July 4.As per a notification issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs on July 8, Justice Khanna will function as officiating chairperson with effect from July 5.He has been appointed for a period of three months or until a regular chairperson is appointed, or unti
